_comment: The approved security surface of the GoFully extension. scripts/verify-package.mjs and tests/security/release-gate.spec.ts both read this file. Changing a permission, host access, web-accessible resource or CSP directive in manifest.json fails them until this file is changed too, so the change shows up in code review.

permissions.activeTab: Capture the tab the person is looking at, only after they ask.
permissions.tabs: Read the title and address of the captured tab for history and filenames; open the editor, review and welcome pages.
permissions.scripting: Scroll the page and hide fixed headers during a full-page capture; inject the on-page tools.
permissions.offscreen: Stitch screenshots and run the local OCR engine in a hidden extension page.
permissions.downloads: Save PNG, JPG, WebP, PDF and Markdown files when the person chooses Save.
permissions.storage: Keep settings, capture history and guides on this device.

hostPermissions.<all_urls>: A screenshot tool has to be able to capture any page the person is on. Nothing is read until the person starts a capture.
